thread:
Anya (PM): FYI — NovaTravel asked for early access to an EU-only Dedicated routing with model-v2. They want staged opt-in and an automatic fallback to model-v1 if latency or hallucination rates spike. Need a rollout and cutover plan by EOD.

Kevin (SRE): Pinged infra about capacity. Quick Q: do we want their traffic isolated to a single pool or soft-sliced across two AZs? Isolation reduces blast radius but ups cost.

Sam (Eng): Prefer isolated pool for first 2 weeks. Easier to trace KV-cache regressions on v2. Can do soft-slice after 2w.

Julie (CSE): NovaTravel will accept opt-in toggles for their tenants. They also require a per-tenant kill switch and audit log for any fallback events.

Anya (PM): Agreed: plan = isolated pool -> opt-in cohort (10%) -> expand 25/50/100 over 2w; rollback to model-v1 on thresholds. Need explicit launch criteria.

Kevin (SRE): Draft thresholds:
- error-rate (5xx + model failures) > 0.3% for 10m -> trigger rollback
- hallucination/regression rate (eval prompt set) > 1.5% -> freeze rollout
- 95p latency increase > 40% vs baseline for EU -> auto-fallback to v1 on >5m sustained

Sam (Eng): Add token-cost budget: if per-request token cost > 1.8x baseline for sustained 30m, reduce rollout to 25% and enable batching suggestions. Also we should enable prefix KV caching.

Julie (CSE): Customer asks for an A/B validation — want a small control group (5%) on v1 to compare quality metrics for first 72h.

Anya (PM): Make that 5% control, 10% opt-in, remainder shadowed for metrics. After 72h we'll decide expand cadence.

Sam (Eng): Proposed feature-flag config (will wire into LaunchConsole):
```yaml
flag: novatravel_eu_v2
cohorts:
  - name: control
    pct: 5
  - name: optin
    pct: 10
  - name: rollout
    pct: 85
rollout_schedule: [10,25,50,100] # percent steps
metrics:
  - latency_95p
  - cost_per_token
  - hallucination_rate
kill_switch: true
fallback_policy:
  type: model_swap
  target: model-v1
  cooldown: 5m
```

Kevin (SRE): Two operational asks:
1) expose a per-tenant "fallback events" webhook to Julie's team for audit + automated incident creation.
2) ensure autoscaler floor is bumped for that dedicated pool during ramp windows.

LaunchBot: NOTE — Canary job scheduled: canary-runner/novatravel-eu at 2024-07-18T14:00Z. It will run end-to-end prompts and baseline checks.

Julie (CSE): I'll confirm the webhook contract with NovaTravel legal (they require retention 90d). Also will coordinate tenant opt-ins on our console.

Sam (Eng): Dev tasks:
- add flag scope for tenant + region (ETA: 1 day)
- implement fallback model swap hook + metric tag (ETA: 2 days)
- add control cohort sampling and export to eval pipeline (ETA: 2 days)

Anya (PM): Launch criteria (must all be green):
1) Canary pass with <0.25% errors and latency within 20% baseline
2) Eval set hallucination delta <= 0.5% vs v1 for control cohort
3) Cost delta within agreed budget (<=1.6x baseline)
4) Webhook + audit logs validated by CSE/legal
5) Autoscaler + pool provisioning confirmed by SRE

Kevin (SRE): I'll provision isolated pool and bump autoscaler floors. Will also add a soft-eviction safety that keeps at least 2 hosts for quick fallback.

Julie (CSE): Customer legal confirmed webhook contract ok. They want an SLA addendum only if we pass full 100% rollout.

Anya (PM): OK — timeline:
- Today: flag + API changes staged in dev, canary scheduled
- +1d: SRE provisions pool, run internal smoke
- +2d: run customer canary (10% opt-in + 5% control)
- +5d: decide expansion to 25/50 based on metrics

Sam (Eng): One more: we should wire automatic datapoints into Redwood Optimize so it can suggest batching/quantization if cost spikes. I'll add tags on the rollout events.

Kevin (SRE): Agreed. Also adding an alert runbook: if fallback triggers >3x in 24h, oncall auto-pager to @Kevin and @Anya.

Anya (PM): Thanks team — I'll author the rollout doc and the CSV of evaluation prompts for customer review. Julie, please schedule a customer sync tomorrow.

Julie (CSE): On it. 

Sam (Eng): I'll open PRs for the flag and fallback hook, assign to Kevin for infra review.

LaunchBot: Canary succeeded (canary-runner/novatravel-eu). Baseline metrics posted to /canaries/1713334444.

Anya (PM): Nice — if metrics look good, we'll start 10% opt-in tomorrow morning. I'll post the official playbook after lunch. :rocket:
